record_type_quote: We replicated their study using data from the 1976 National Survey of Family Growth.

targets.evidence_quote: Jones and Westoff (1979) reported a study of fertility trends among white women in intact first marriages.
targets.outcome_quote: We found that the fertility of the two religious groups was indeed converging, but the Catholic-non-Catholic differential was larger than that found by Jones and Westoff --how much larger depends on what measure is used. Moreover, we found that the differential by frequency of communion among Catholic wives was not converging.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract reports agreement on fertility convergence between religious groups but disagreement on convergence by communion frequency.
